surat.headline: Surat cluster faces input-cost and labor strains despite positive policy and demand shifts.
what_changed: Yarn prices surged by 45% to 66%, forcing early closures and shutdown risks for loom and textile units [b567711c9ed4, 1b54f570ed7b, b62552cc0c7d].
Embroidery workers staged protests and labor strikes over wages, leave, and police cases, leading to worker detentions and reverse migration [7697e96a190e, d6a4b0e6a74b, 6b7974c7f88e].
Surat diamond exports dropped 7% due to a polished shipment slump, though shortened Diwali vacations signal improving demand [975918f112f3, 2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Surat loom units face early closure 15 days before Diwali due to yarn price hikes [b567711c9ed4].
70 traders were blacklisted for defaulting on Rs 62 crore in viscose weavers' dues [a70c9ae52e8d].
Multiple cheating cases involving yarn, fabric, and diamond traders totaling crores were filed [2718cba9f837].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted ITC refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
Surat diamond industry shortened its traditional Diwali vacation duration after four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
what_to_watch: Working capital erosion and liquidity pressures in upstream weaving units due to sharp yarn price increases.
Resolution of embroidery sector labor disputes and potential impact on job-work operations.
Account-level repayment track records and overdue developments in grey fabric and trading segments.
